why: On head, parsing `--no-dice` with `boolean: ['dice']`, unknown-options-as-args on and boolean-negation off gives `{"_":[],"no-dice":true}`: the negated flag counts as known and gets parsed as 'no-dice'. On base, the same input passes through to `_` as `['--no-dice']`.
